title: Metric TSP Subtour LP Integrality Gap Conjecture
exact_target: Is the true optimal metric traveling-salesman tour always within a factor four-thirds of the subtour linear-programming bound, with that factor sharp?

sources.citation: J. Qian, F. Schalekamp, D. P. Williamson, A. van Zuylen, On the integrality gap of the subtour LP for the 1,2-TSP, Math. Program. 148 (2014) 411-417.
